verdict.rationale: Claude Code offers several programmatic surfaces. The Agent SDK exposes Claude Code's tools and capabilities with full control over orchestration, tool access and permissions. The CLI is composable and scriptable (pipe logs, run in CI, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), and `claude mcp serve` lets other apps drive it as an MCP server. Nothing, however, documents that every UI capability (desktop visual diff review, cloud/web sessions, scheduling, Remote Control) is reachable through an API, so parity is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity documentation, a programmatic API for web/cloud sessions and scheduled tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
